Inflicts more damage than a civilian bow, but it will still burn if it touches fire.|Allies|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Bow |strength = 14 |durability = 36 |flammable = Yes |magnetic = No |buoyant = Yes |conductive = No |guardian = No |throw = |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Soldier's Bow}} Soldier's Bows are [[Bow]]s designed for armed conflict, and they will therefore deal more damage than their civilian counterparts. They are used by [[Enemy|Enemies]] across [[Hyrule]], especially in [[Hyrule Field]] and the [[Faron Grasslands]]. The following [[amiibo]] have a chance to spawn a [[Treasure Chest]] containing a Soldier's Bow when they are scanned with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]]: * {{SSB}} Series [[Princess Zelda]] amiibo * {{BotW}} Series [[Link]] (Archer) amiibo * {{BotW|-}} Series [[Revali]] amiibo Despite their upgrades, Soldier's Bows will burn if they are exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]], and they cannot be picked up using the [[Magnesis]] Rune. They will float if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], and they will not attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s or conduct [[Electricity]]. Soldier's Bows belong to the [[Soldier's Gear]] equipment archetype, which is associated with the [[Hylian Knight]]s from before the [[Great Calamity]].{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 169}} {{BotW Bow Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Bow_002" |Life = 36 |Power = 14 |Range = 20.0 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 3 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 6 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 3 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 6 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 7 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 11 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 7 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 11 |PoweredSharpAddSpreadFire = false |PoweredSharpAddZoomRapid = false |PoweredSharpAddRapidFireMin = 1.1 |PoweredSharpAddRapidFireMax = 1.3 |ArrowName = "" |IsLeadShot = false |LeadShotNum = 0 |LeadShotAng = 45.0 |IsRapidFire = false |RapidFireNum = 0 |ArrowGravity = -9.8 |ArrowChargeRate = 1.0 |ArrowReloadRate = 1.0 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Soldier's Bow}} {{Stub|TotK}} {{TotK Item Properties/Store |type = Bow |strength = 14 |durability = |flammable = Yes |magnetic = |buoyant = Yes |conductive = No |guardian = }} Soldier's Bows appear in {{TotK}}. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{AoC Item Properties/Store |type= Revali Weapon }} {{Stub|AoC}} {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:AoC Soldier's Bow Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Icon of the Soldier's Bow ==See Also== {{See Also| * Bow * Soldier's Gear }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Bows, Soldier's Gear, Weapons |items= BotW, TotK, AoC }}
